description: This Java class implements a strategy for handling the ModifyPolicyId command within the Eclipse Ditto framework, managing policy ID modifications for 'Thing' entities.

classes.name: ModifyPolicyIdStrategy
classes.description: A strategy class that handles the modification of policy IDs for 'Thing' entities, implementing logic to create appropriate events and responses based on whether a policy ID exists.

methods.name: doApply
methods.description: Executes the strategy to modify or create a policy ID, returning the result of the operation.

methods.name: extractPolicyId
methods.description: Extracts the PolicyId from a 'Thing' entity if present.

methods.name: getModifyResult
methods.description: Generates a result indicating a policy ID modification event.

methods.name: getCreateResult
methods.description: Generates a result indicating a new policy ID creation event.

methods.name: previousEntityTag
methods.description: Retrieves the entity tag of the previous 'Thing' entity.

methods.name: nextEntityTag
methods.description: Retrieves the entity tag for the new 'Thing' entity based on the command.
